name: Build and deploy exe
description: Build, then copy out/build Motiva.exe + MotivaBrowserHost.exe and scripts/extension/ (without tests) to out/deployment/resources/bin using staged, backed-up, best-effort-rollback replacement (not atomic). Qt kit/toolchain must match out/build/CMakeCache.txt (never reconfigured). Never kills processes; stops if Motiva runs from out/. Input (strict JSON types): dry_run, qt_root (default C:\Qt or MOTIVA_QT_ROOT), skip_build (refused unless artifacts are newer than all build inputs), allow_stale_artifacts (explicit override for skip_build).
